tasks.description: Prisma migration: AnnouncementStatus/AudienceType enums; Announcement (+lastRemindedAt), AnnouncementAudience, AnnouncementAttachment, AnnouncementRead models exactly per PRD FR-1 block; indexes from system-design §1; back-relations User.announcements, User.announcementReads, FileObject.announcementAttachments. Run prisma migrate dev --name add_announcements under the fixed folder name.

Shared Zod schemas mirroring api-contracts components: audienceRowSchema (refId/flag refinements), announcementInputSchema (title ≤150 trimmed, body ≤20000, audiences ≤20, attachments ≤10, mode, schedule-in-future, expiresAt > publishAt), announcementPatchSchema, feedQuerySchema, manageQuerySchema, statsQuerySchema, previewAudienceSchema. Unit test of limits and refinements.

toPlainText(md, max) with about six regexes (code fences, images, links keep text, HTML tags, emphasis, heading and list markers), whitespace collapse and … truncation. Add a ponytail: comment for the remark/strip-markdown upgrade path. Unit test.

Generic audience service (no Announcement imports): AudienceRow type, getAudienceKeys(userId) (≤~4 indexed queries, childByKey for parents), pure matchesAudience, isUserInAudience, audienceWhere(keys) Prisma fragment, resolveAudienceUserIds (ACTIVE/non-archived, parents only via ACTIVE students, archived courses excluded), countAudienceByRole, audienceLabels. Unit test matchesAudience for every type × flag × role with hand-built keys.

Register notification types 'announcement.published' (COMMUNICATION, defaultEmail true, mandatoryInApp false, ALL roles) and 'announcement.reminder' (COMMUNICATION, defaultEmail true, mandatoryInApp true). Add optional NotifyInput.mandatoryInApp override passed to resolvePrefs (one-line change, A9).

announcements-service.ts write side: visibleWhere, isVisible, displayStatus, assertCanTarget (admin anything; teacher COURSE as teacherId/coTeacherIds, SECTION as homeroom; else 403), createAnnouncement (transaction + attachFiles, zero-recipient NO_RECIPIENTS check except drafts), updateAnnouncement (author/admin else 404, archived non-admin 409, PUBLISHED→draft 409, retarget check on resulting values, audit on admin edits, never clears notifiedAt), archiveAnnouncement (idempotent, audit), claimAndNotify (atomic notifiedAt claim, chunks of 1000, generic-notification email, 300-char body, mandatoryInApp = requiresAck). Unit test assertCanTarget cases.

announcements-service.ts read side: listFeed (tabs, courseId filter after assertCanViewCourse, ≤3 pinned on page 1 excluded from main list and meta.total, publishAt desc/id desc, FeedItem DTO with excerpt, labels, unread, forChildren), unreadCount, getForViewer (404 for non-members, readAt upsert keeping first), acknowledge (409 if !requiresAck, idempotent), previewAudience, listManage (live reach/readPct/ackPct, ?status on displayStatus, pageSize ≤50), getStats, statsCsv (toCsv, school timezone), sendReminder (lastRemindedAt claim, 429 with retryAfter, notified = recipients − acked), getPublicNews (public-safe DTO).

publishDueAnnouncements(now): findMany SCHEDULED ∧ notifiedAt null ∧ publishAt ≤ now, take 50, claimAndNotify each, log { claimed } with logger (copy the quiz/maintenance.ts pattern). Add an isolated try/catch pass to the dispatch route, with an announcementsPublished counter.

announcementFileResolver(user|null, file): public ∧ visible → allow (anonymous too); otherwise no user → deny; ADMIN/author → allow; visible ∧ isUserInAudience → allow; else deny. Register 'announcement' in registerBuiltInContexts.

Collection route handlers (withHandler → requireUser/requireRole → parseQuery/parseBody → one service call → ok/paginated): GET/POST /api/announcements, GET unread-count, POST preview-audience, GET manage.
Item route handlers: GET/PATCH /api/announcements/[id], POST archive, POST ack, GET stats (format=csv → text/csv + Content-Disposition 'announcement-<id>-recipients.csv'), POST remind.
GET /api/public/news: no auth, rateLimit by client IP, parsePagination, getPublicNews. Add '/api/public/news' to PUBLIC_API_PATHS.

Sidebar: add optional NavItem.badgeEndpoint and an Announcements entry (ALL_ROLES, badgeEndpoint '/api/announcements/unread-count'). shell.tsx wraps the icon in MUI Badge for items with badgeEndpoint and polls every 30 s while the page is visible, copying NotificationBell.

Feed page /announcements: server page (requireUser) with PageHeader and a 'New announcement' button for ADMIN/TEACHER. AnnouncementFeed client component (MUI Tabs All/Unread/Requires acknowledgement, Pagination, EmptyState; takes an optional courseId so the course tab can reuse it). AnnouncementCard (CardMedia cover via /api/files/:id, title, author and role, formatInSchoolTz date, label Chips, 'For <child>' Chip, plain-text excerpt, attachment count, unread dot with visuallyHidden 'Unread'). Look up MUI components via mui-mcp.

Detail page /announcements/[id]: server page calls getForViewer (notFound on 404). AnnouncementDetailView renders MarkdownView body, FileList attachments, the 'I acknowledge' Button → POST ack → disabled 'Acknowledged on 14 Sep' (formatInSchoolTz), and Edit/Stats links when canEdit/canViewStats. Errors via useToast.

Composer: AnnouncementComposer (react-hook-form + zodResolver(announcementInputSchema): TextField title, MarkdownEditor, cover FileUpload (context 'announcement'), attachments FileUpload + FileList, Switches for pinned/requiresAck/isPublic (admins only), RadioGroup publish/schedule/draft, DateTimePickers converted from the school timezone to UTC) and AudienceBuilder (rows of Select type → Autocomplete entity from existing grade-level/section/course APIs, teachers limited to own courses and homeroom → 3 Checkboxes; 400 ms debounced preview line). /announcements/new and /announcements/[id]/edit server pages (ADMIN/TEACHER; edit 404 unless canEdit).

Manage page /announcements/manage (DataTable: displayStatus chip, title, audience summary, reach, read %, ack %; row actions Edit, Stats, Archive via ConfirmDialog) and stats page /announcements/[id]/stats (StatCards recipients/read %/ack %, recipient DataTable with Unread/Not acknowledged ToggleButtonGroup, Export CSV link, Send reminder via ConfirmDialog with a 429 toast showing retry time). Server pages require ADMIN/TEACHER.
Course tab: register { key 'announcements', label 'Announcements', roles ALL_ROLES } in course-tabs.ts. Course page uses AnnouncementFeed with courseId behind assertCanViewCourse.

Seed 6 announcements, idempotent by (title, authorId): school welcome (pinned, public), Grade 7 parents field-trip consent (requiresAck), MATH-7A homework club by Tom, staff meeting (STAFF), sports day scheduled +2 days (public), expired exam timetable. Skip a seed when its target is missing. Published seeds get notifiedAt = now so seeding never sends notifications.

Integration tests: audience-agreement (isUserInAudience === resolveAudienceUserIds membership for every seed and fixture user × every row type), publish (publishDueAnnouncements twice and concurrently → one notification set; PATCH never re-notifies; AC-4), api (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3 403, AC-5 60%/20 notified/429, AC-6, AC-7, AC-8 with a fixture creating Pat's 6A child and ParentStudentLink).
Playwright e2e: admin composes a Grade 7 parents announcement with requiresAck, Pat reads and acknowledges, admin opens stats and sees the acknowledgement.
